# TaxJar Integration for ERPNext

> US sales tax for ERPNext, calculated by TaxJar and filed with AutoFile.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/getting-started/introduction

# Introduction

TaxJar helps you manage your whole sales tax lifecycle from tax computation to return filing, with TaxJar Integration in place you will be able to do all of this inside ERPNext.

## Features

![Four icons: jurisdiction-based tax rates, state nexus management, tax exemption management and sales tax return filing](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/why-taxjar-light.webp)

### Sales Tax Rates

The United States has about 12,000 jurisdictions, each with its own combination of tax rates. TaxJar keeps up with the latest rates across all of them, so you always charge the correct tax.

![A map of the United States with the number of sales tax jurisdictions in each state, from 0 in Oregon to 1,659 in Texas. Source: Vertex, Inc.](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-jurisdictions-map.webp)

### State Nexus Management

Each of the 50 states has its own threshold for when you must start to collect sales tax: a sales amount, a number of transactions, or both. TaxJar tracks your sales against these thresholds in every state.

![TaxJar cards for states where you may have economic nexus, with the sales and the number of transactions against the limit of each state](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-nexus-thresholds.webp)

### Tax Exemption Management

Some products are exempt in some states, for example clothing is taxed in California but not in New Jersey. Some customers, such as resellers, are exempt too. TaxJar keeps these rules and applies them on each sale.

![The TaxJar Product Category Lookup with the categories, their codes and descriptions, for example Clothing 20010](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-product-categories.webp)

![The TaxJar Tax Exempt Customers list with the exemption type, the exempt region and the certificate of each customer](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-exempt-customers.webp)

### Sales Tax Return Filing

Each state needs its own sales tax return, which is a lot of work across many states. With TaxJar, you know your tax liability in each state, and with TaxJar AutoFile, you file the returns for all your states with one click.

![The TaxJar sales tax report for New York for one quarter, with the tax collected and the button Enroll in AutoFile](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-state-return.webp)

Next, read the [Walkthrough](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/getting-started/walkthrough) to see what you can do in ERPNext, and watch a video of all features.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/getting-started/walkthrough

# Walkthrough

## Sales Tax Lifecycle

This video shows all the features that we support as a part of the integration.

[Video: TaxJar in ERPNext: a walkthrough of all features](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y-ppuE5RsLg)

## TaxJar Workspace

A dedicated space to manage all your sales tax operations.

![The TaxJar workspace in ERPNext, with the TaxJar sidebar, the banner "Configure TaxJar Integration" with the link to the guided setup, and the Manage, Report and Other cards](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/taxjar-workspace.webp)

We will first go through the guided setup, nexus states and product tax categories. Then we will see how to manage transactions and tax exemptions. {.section-intro}

### Setting Up

:::tabs
== Guided Setup
Connect each company to TaxJar by adding the API credentials, mapping the ledgers, setting the company address, choosing the features, and syncing your nexus.

![The Connect step with API Mode set to Live, one company with a green Connected status, and the API log settings](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step2-connect.webp)

For each step in detail, refer to [Guided Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#continue-with-setup).
== Nexus & Product Category
Review & fetch your state nexus & product tax category list.

![The Manage nexus & product category page with the nexus states of one company, Arizona and New York, and 870 product tax categories, each with its sync time and a refresh button](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/nexus-page.webp)
:::

### Manage Transactions

:::tabs
== Sales Tax
When you save a quotation, sales order, sales invoice, credit note or debit note, ERPNext gets the sales tax from TaxJar and adds it to the taxes table.

![A submitted Sales Invoice with the status Unpaid, and the shipping row and the sales tax row in the Sales Taxes and Charges table](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-sales-tax.webp)
== Jurisdiction based tax
See the tax for each jurisdiction: state, county, city and special district.

![The TaxJar Tax Breakdown of a Sales Invoice with the rate and the tax for the state, Cook County, the city of Chicago and a special district, and a total of 10.5%](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-tax-breakdown.webp)
== Tax Applicability Matrix
Analyze the transaction for origin or destination based tax, and assess the tax applicability based on parameters.

![The TaxJar tab of a submitted Sales Invoice with Ship From Los Angeles, Ship To Chicago with destination based tax, and the three Yes cards of the Tax Applicability Matrix](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-tax-matrix.webp)
== Sync Report
Reconcile & check the sync status of submitted invoices, credit notes and debit notes before you file your tax returns.

![The TaxJar Transaction Sync page for the company Nova Tech, with the counts of failed, queued, synced, draft and excluded transactions, and a table of sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes with their sync status](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/sync-report.webp)
:::

### Manage Tax Exemptions

:::tabs
== Customer Exemption
Classify customers as exempted in specific regions based on their type: Wholesale, Government, Other.

![The TaxJar Customer Configuration page with the counts of total, exempted, non-exempted and not configured customers, and a table of eight customers with their exemption type, exempted regions and sync status](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customer-exemption-bulk.webp)
== Product Exemption
Set a **Product Tax Category** on an item so that TaxJar can assess the tax applicability based on the state.

![A new item, Sparkling Mineral Water, with the Product Tax Category Bottled Water, code 40060, selected from the list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/item-product-exemption.webp)
:::

### Tax Returns & Liability

:::tabs
== State-wise Tax Liability
Know your tax liability across all the states.

![The TaxJar sales tax insights dashboard with Arizona and New York, the next filing due date, the filing frequency, the actual sales tax collected and the buttons Sales Tax Report and Enroll in AutoFile for each state](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/taxjar-insights-dashboard.webp)
== Sales Tax Report
See your sales tax liability for each state and filing period, and file your returns with AutoFile.

![The TaxJar sales tax report for New York for one quarter, with the gross sales, the tax collected for each jurisdiction, the minimum sales tax due and the button Enroll in AutoFile](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/intro-state-return.webp)
:::

# Installation

Install the app from the branch that matches your Frappe and ERPNext branch. Use **Version 16** for a live site.

| Branch | Frappe Framework | ERPNext | Python |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Version 16** | 16.50.0 or later | 16.52.0 or later | 3.14 or later |
| **Develop** | `develop` | `develop` | 3.14 or later |

## Frappe Cloud

If you do not have a Frappe site yet, Frappe Cloud is the quickest way to start. The app is not in the Frappe Cloud marketplace, so you add it from GitHub.

:::tabs key:branch
== Version 16
1. Sign up on [Frappe Cloud](https://cloud.frappe.io/dashboard/signup) and create a bench group with the version **Version 16**.
2. Add ERPNext to the bench group.
3. Add the TaxJar Integration app from GitHub: `https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration`, branch `version-16`.
4. Deploy the bench group, then create a site on it with ERPNext and TaxJar Integration.
== Develop
1. Sign up on [Frappe Cloud](https://cloud.frappe.io/dashboard/signup) and create a bench group with the version **Nightly**. Nightly is the `develop` branch.
2. Add ERPNext to the bench group.
3. Add the TaxJar Integration app from GitHub: `https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration`, branch `develop`.
4. Deploy the bench group, then create a site on it with ERPNext and TaxJar Integration.
:::

## Docker

To run the app with Docker, build a custom image. In the [frappe_docker](https://github.com/frappe/frappe_docker) folder, create an `apps.json` file, then build the image.

:::tabs key:branch
== Version 16
```json
[
  {
    "url": "https://github.com/frappe/erpnext",
    "branch": "version-16"
  },
  {
    "url": "https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration",
    "branch": "version-16"
  }
]
```

```bash
docker build \
 --no-cache \
 --build-arg=FRAPPE_PATH=https://github.com/frappe/frappe \
 --build-arg=FRAPPE_BRANCH=version-16 \
 --secret=id=apps_json,src=apps.json \
 --tag=custom:taxjar \
 --file=images/layered/Containerfile .
```
== Develop
```json
[
  {
    "url": "https://github.com/frappe/erpnext",
    "branch": "develop"
  },
  {
    "url": "https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration",
    "branch": "develop"
  }
]
```

```bash
docker build \
 --no-cache \
 --build-arg=FRAPPE_PATH=https://github.com/frappe/frappe \
 --build-arg=FRAPPE_BRANCH=develop \
 --secret=id=apps_json,src=apps.json \
 --tag=custom:taxjar \
 --file=images/layered/Containerfile .
```
:::

For the other options, refer to the [Frappe Docker build guide](https://github.com/frappe/frappe_docker/blob/main/docs/02-setup/02-build-setup.md).

## Manual

If you run your own bench, follow the [Frappe installation guide](https://docs.frappe.io/framework/user/en/installation) first. Then make a bench with Frappe and ERPNext, and get the app:

:::tabs key:branch
== Version 16
```bash
bench init --frappe-branch version-16 frappe-bench
cd frappe-bench
bench get-app --branch version-16 erpnext
bench get-app --branch version-16 https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration
```
== Develop
```bash
bench init --frappe-branch develop frappe-bench
cd frappe-bench
bench get-app --branch develop erpnext
bench get-app --branch develop https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration
```
:::

Install the app on your site, and migrate:

```bash
bench --site [site name] install-app taxjar_integration
bench --site [site name] migrate
```

## What the app adds to your site

When you install the app, it adds these items:

- The **TaxJar** app on the ERPNext apps screen, with a banner that opens TaxJar Setup.
- TaxJar fields on items, addresses, quotations, sales orders and sales invoices.
- The product tax categories from TaxJar, about 800 codes.
- The print format **US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN)**. Refer to [Print Format](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/print-format).

The app does not calculate tax until you connect a company in TaxJar Setup.

::: tip Need help?
If the installation fails, [open an issue on GitHub](https://github.com/frappe/taxjar_integration/issues/new). If the site has TaxJar version 15, refer to [Upgrade from Version 15](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/upgrade-from-version-15).
:::

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup

# Guided Setup

We will see how to connect TaxJar to ERPNext through the guided setup experience.

![The TaxJar Setup page in the TaxJar workspace, on the Pre-requisites step, with the six step names, the Setup TaxJar video card, the four checklist items and the Continue button](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/guided-setup-start.webp)

## Pre-requisites

Before we continue with the setup, we need to get done with the following tasks:

1. TaxJar Account Setup
2. Review Ledger Accounts

---

### TaxJar Account Setup

Before you connect, your TaxJar account needs your nexus states and an API token.

:::tabs
== Sign Up
We need to sign up for a free trial. After 30 days, you need to upgrade to a TaxJar Professional plan to keep using it.

1. Open the [TaxJar sign-up page](https://app.taxjar.com/api_sign_up).

[Video: Sign up for TaxJar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RnyQMNnjME&t=27)
== API Key
After sign up, let's get our API token to connect to ERPNext.

1. Open the [API Access page](https://app.taxjar.com/account#api-access).
2. Copy the **Live** / **Sandbox** token.

[Video: Get the API token from TaxJar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RnyQMNnjME&t=54)
== Manage Nexus
Let's set up state nexus to start collecting taxes for that region.

1. Open the [Nexus Address Configuration page](https://app.taxjar.com/account#api-access:~:text=Nexus%20Address%20Configuration).
2. Click **Add State with Nexus** and add each state where you collect sales tax.

[Video: Configure nexus in TaxJar](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RnyQMNnjME&t=66)
:::

### Review Ledger Accounts

Let's check that the chart of accounts has the two ledger accounts that the setup needs.

:::tabs
== Sales Tax Ledger
This ledger holds the sales tax that you owe to the state.

1. Open the **Chart of Accounts** of your company.
2. Check for **Sales Tax Payable** (21410) under **Sales Tax Liabilities**. It must be a Liability account. If it is missing, add it as a ledger.

![The Chart of Accounts tree with Sales Tax Payable 21410 under Sales Tax Liabilities](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/before-coa-sales-tax.webp)
== Shipping Ledger
This ledger holds the shipping and handling fees that you charge to customers.

1. Open the **Chart of Accounts** of your company.
2. Check for **Shipping and Freight Income** (41300) under **Sales Revenue**. It must be an Income or Expense account. If it is missing, add it as a ledger.

![The Chart of Accounts tree with Shipping and Freight Income 41300 under Sales Revenue](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/before-coa-shipping.webp)
:::

## Continue with Setup

Since the pre-requisites are in place, let's see what are the steps involved in completing the setup.

[Video: The six steps of TaxJar Setup](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2RnyQMNnjME&t=113)

<ol class="steps">
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="connect">Connect</h3><span>Connect each company to TaxJar with its API token.</span></summary>

![The Connect step with API Mode set to Live, one company with a green Connected status, and the API log settings](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step2-connect.webp)

1. In **API Mode**, select **Live** or **Sandbox**.
2. Select the **Company**, and paste its API token.
3. Click **Connect**, and wait for the green **Connected** status.
4. Click **Save & continue**.

To add more companies, click **Add another company**. **Enable API Logs** keeps a log of each call to TaxJar for 15 days.

::: tip If Connect fails
The button changes to **Retry**. Check that the token is for the selected mode. Refer to [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors#setup-messages).
:::

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="map-ledgers">Map Ledgers</h3><span>Select the sales tax and shipping ledger accounts.</span></summary>

![The Map Ledgers step with Sales Tax Payable and Shipping and Freight Income selected for one company](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step3-ledgers.webp)

1. Check **Sales Tax Ledger Account** and **Shipping Ledger Account** for each company.
2. If a field is empty, select an account.
3. Click **Save & continue**.

The app then makes the tax template **TaxJar Sales Tax**, with a shipping row and a sales tax row.

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="address">Address</h3><span>Select the company address that TaxJar uses as the ship-from address.</span></summary>

![The Address step with the company address and the green Valid badge](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step4-address.webp)

1. Select the **Company Address**. If there is none, click **Add address**.
2. Wait for the green **Valid** badge. In Sandbox mode, the badge shows **Skipped**. You can continue.
3. Click **Save & continue**.

**Add address** opens this dialog. Fill in the street, city, state code and postal code.

![The New address dialog with the street, city, state code and postal code filled in, and Preferred Billing Address selected](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-address-dialog.webp)

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="features">Features</h3><span>Turn on the tax calculation and the transaction sync.</span></summary>

![The Features step with Compute Taxes on Sales and Sync Transactions to TaxJar selected, and Domestic + Export set](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step5-features.webp)

1. Select **Compute Taxes on Sales** to get the tax on quotations, sales orders and invoices.
2. Select **Sync Transactions to TaxJar** to send your invoices to TaxJar for AutoFile.
3. Select **Domestic + Export** to also sync export transactions with TaxJar, or **Domestic only** to sync US sales only.
4. Click **Save & continue**.

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="sync-nexus">Sync Nexus</h3><span>Load your nexus states from TaxJar, and activate the setup.</span></summary>

![The Sync Nexus step with the blue banner about the daily update and the nexus states of one company](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-step6-nexus.webp)

1. Wait for **Synced**. Your nexus states show as labels.
2. If a state is missing, click **Manage TaxJar Nexus**, add it in TaxJar, then click the refresh icon.
3. Click **Activate**.

The app updates your nexus states from TaxJar each day.

</details></li>
</ol>

## Summary

The screen shows **TaxJar is configured**, with a summary of the configuration of all companies. To make changes, click **Edit configuration**.

![The TaxJar is configured screen with the Edit configuration button, the Walkthrough video card, the Connection card with Live mode and API logs, and the card of Nova Inc with its 3 nexus regions, ledgers, features and address](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/setup-summary.webp)

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions

# Roles & Permissions

TaxJar app doesn't publish its own roles, rather uses standard roles defined by ERPNext to carry out operations.

## Personas

A persona describes the TaxJar operations that a person carries out. It is not a role: it controls only the TaxJar pages, the update buttons and the nexus notification, and gives no rights on ERPNext documents.

Choose the persona that fits the person's work, then give the person the role in its tab.

:::tabs
== TaxJar Manager
Sets up TaxJar and keeps it running: the guided setup, the nexus states and the product tax categories.

**Role:** <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> gives write access to **TaxJar Settings**.
== TaxJar User
Works with TaxJar every day: invoices, sync problems and the period close.

**Role:** <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> gives read access to **TaxJar Settings**.
:::

## Roles for Each Task

Find each task that the person carries out, and give the person the roles of that task. A person who carries out tasks in more than one tab needs the roles from each tab.

:::tabs
== Setting Up
| Task | Role |
|---|---|
| Do TaxJar Setup | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> and <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> |
| Update the nexus states or the product tax categories from TaxJar | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| Add, change or delete product tax categories by hand | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| Run the version 15 invoice check | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| View the nexus states and the product tax categories | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
== Tax Exemptions
| Task | Role |
|---|---|
| Set or clear a customer exemption, or send a customer to TaxJar | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" />, and <Badge type="info" text="Sales User" /> |
| View and export the customer list | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| Create customers and their addresses | <Badge type="info" text="Sales User" /> |
| Set the product tax category on an item | <Badge type="info" text="Item Manager" /> |
== Sales & Invoices
| Task | Role |
|---|---|
| Make quotations and sales orders with TaxJar tax | <Badge type="info" text="Sales User" /> |
| Make sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes with TaxJar tax | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| Send a failed invoice to TaxJar again | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| View and export the transaction list | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
== Troubleshoot
| Task | Role |
|---|---|
| Read the TaxJar API Log | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
| Get the notification when the daily nexus update fails | <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> or <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" /> |
:::

## Assign Roles to a User

If you cannot change users in ERPNext, ask your ERPNext administrator to assign the roles.

1. Open the **User**.
2. Go to the **Roles** section.
3. Select the roles from [Roles for Each Task](#roles-for-each-task).
4. Save the user.

![The Roles section of a User form with Accounts User and Sales User ticked](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/user-roles-section.webp)

## Permissions by Task

To make a custom role, give it the permissions with a dot in the row of each task.

:::tabs
== Setting Up
| Task | DocType | Read | Write | Create | Submit | Delete |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Do TaxJar Setup | TaxJar Settings | ● | ● |  |  |  |
|  | Company | ● |  |  |  |  |
|  | Account | ● |  |  |  |  |
|  | Address | ● | ● | ● |  |  |
| Update the nexus states or the product tax categories from TaxJar | TaxJar Settings | ● | ● |  |  |  |
| Add, change or delete product tax categories by hand | Product Tax Category | ● | ● | ● |  | ● |
| Run the version 15 invoice check | TaxJar Settings | ● | ● |  |  |  |
| View the nexus states and the product tax categories | TaxJar Settings | ● |  |  |  |  |
== Tax Exemptions
| Task | DocType | Read | Write | Create | Submit | Delete |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Set or clear a customer exemption, or send a customer to TaxJar | Customer | ● | ● |  |  |  |
|  | Company | ● |  |  |  |  |
| View and export the customer list | Customer | ● |  |  |  |  |
| Create customers and their addresses | Customer | ● |  | ● |  |  |
|  | Address | ● |  | ● |  |  |
| Set the product tax category on an item | Item | ● | ● |  |  |  |
== Sales & Invoices
| Task | DocType | Read | Write | Create | Submit | Delete |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Make quotations and sales orders with TaxJar tax | Quotation | ● | ● | ● | ● |  |
|  | Sales Order | ● | ● | ● | ● |  |
| Make sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes with TaxJar tax | Sales Invoice | ● | ● | ● | ● |  |
| Send a failed invoice to TaxJar again | Sales Invoice | ● | ● |  |  |  |
| View and export the transaction list | Sales Invoice | ● |  |  |  |  |
== Troubleshoot
| Task | DocType | Read | Write | Create | Submit | Delete |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|:-:|
| Read the TaxJar API Log | TaxJar API Log | ● |  |  |  |  |
| Get the notification when the daily nexus update fails | TaxJar Settings | ● |  |  |  |  |
:::

To make documents, ERPNext needs more rights than the table shows, for example on Item and Price List. Start from Sales User or Accounts User, and add what they do not have.

## Page Access

A user opens a page only when one of their roles is on the page.

| Page | Page ID | Accounts Manager | Accounts User |
|---|---|:-:|:-:|
| TaxJar Setup | `taxjar-setup` | ● |  |
| Nexus & Product Category | `taxjar-nexus` | ● | ● |
| Customer Tax Exemption | `taxjar-customers` | ● | ● |
| TaxJar Transaction Sync | `taxjar-transactions` | ● | ● |
| TaxJar Integration workspace | - | ● | ● |

The Customer Tax Exemption page opens for Accounts roles, but an exemption needs write on Customer. With the standard roles, a person who changes exemptions on this page needs an Accounts role and Sales User.

## Custom Roles

A standard role gives permissions on more than TaxJar. For example, Sales User can also make and change quotations and sales orders. A custom role gives only the permissions of the TaxJar tasks that the person carries out.

::: tip
If you cannot make roles in ERPNext, ask your ERPNext administrator to make the custom role.
:::

1. Make a new **Role**.
2. In **Role Permission Manager**, give the role the permissions of each task that the person carries out. The permissions are in [Permissions by Task](#permissions-by-task).
3. In **Role Permission for Page and Report**, add the role to each page that the tasks use. The page IDs are in [Page Access](#page-access).
4. Add the role to the **TaxJar Integration** workspace, so that the person sees the TaxJar app. App updates keep this change.
5. Give the role to the user, as in [Assign Roles to a User](#assign-roles-to-a-user).

## Permission Errors

When a user does not have a permission, ERPNext shows this message:

> You do not have {right} access to {document type}, ask your administrator to update permissions for your user.

Find the task in [Permissions by Task](#permissions-by-task), and give the missing role or permission.

## Automatic Updates

The app writes these records itself: the TaxJar API Log entries, the sync status on invoices and customers, the TaxJar Sales Tax template, and the product tax categories from TaxJar.

If a user has **User Permissions** on Company, the TaxJar pages show only the documents of those companies.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus

# Updating your nexus

You collect sales tax only in the states where you have nexus, so a customer in any other state pays no sales tax. You manage your nexus states in TaxJar, and the app copies them to ERPNext every day.

## Add Nexus State

1. In TaxJar, go to **Account → API Access → Nexus Address Configuration**, and add the state. [Open the page in TaxJar](https://app.taxjar.com/account#api-access:~:text=Nexus%20Address%20Configuration)
2. In ERPNext, [sync the nexus](#on-demand-nexus-sync) to get the new state at once. If you do not, the daily update adds it.

## On-Demand Nexus Sync

![The State Nexus section with the Synced caption, the refresh icon with the tooltip "Fetch nexus regions from TaxJar", and the nexus states of one company](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/nexus-sync-tooltip.webp)

You need to be a TaxJar Manager. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions).

1. In the TaxJar sidebar, click **Nexus & Product Category**.
2. In **State Nexus**, click the refresh icon.
3. Wait for the message "Nexus regions fetched and updated."
4. Check that the new state is in the company card. If a company has more than six states, click **+{n} more** to see all of them.

## Daily Update Failure

If the daily update cannot get the nexus for a company, each TaxJar Manager and TaxJar User gets a notification under the bell icon. The notification names the cause, for example:

> TaxJar refreshed no nexus for {company}. No usable API credential.

Until you fix the cause, the app uses the last nexus states that it got, so the tax calculation continues.

1. Click the notification. **Nexus & Product Category** opens.
2. Fix the cause. For a credential cause, check the token of the company in [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#connect).
3. [Sync the nexus](#on-demand-nexus-sync). The **Synced** time changes only when the sync succeeds for all companies.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/address-validation

# Address Validation

TaxJar uses two addresses to find the tax rate: the company address is the "ship from" address, and the customer address is the "ship to" address. A missing state code or postal code stops the calculation.

For the ship-to address, TaxJar uses the **Shipping Address** of the document. If it is empty when you save, the app asks you to select one of the customer's addresses, or to add a new one. A document with a **Billing Address** in another country needs no Shipping Address.

## Address Fields

The fields that an address needs vary based on the country.

:::tabs
== United States
| Field | Required | Note |
|---|:-:|---|
| **Address Line 1** | ● | |
| **City/Town** | ● | |
| **State/Province** | ● | The full state name, for example California. |
| **State Code (US)** | ● | The app fills it in from the state. When you select a code, the app fills in the state. |
| **Postal Code** | ● | |
| **Country** | ● | |

![The Address form with State/Province, State Code (US), Country and Postal Code filled in](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/address-state-code.webp)
== Canada
| Field | Required | Note |
|---|:-:|---|
| **Address Line 1** | ● | |
| **City/Town** | ● | |
| **State/Province** | ● | The province, for example Ontario. |
| **Region Code (ISO 3166-2)** | Auto | The app fills it in from the province, for example `ON`. |
| **Country** | ● | |
== Other Countries
| Field | Required | Note |
|---|:-:|---|
| **Address Line 1** | ● | |
| **City/Town** | ● | |
| **State/Province** | | Fill it in, so that the app can find the region code. |
| **Region Code (ISO 3166-2)** | Auto | The app fills it in from the state. If no region matches, the app uses `XX`, which TaxJar accepts. |
| **Country** | ● | |

TaxJar charges no US sales tax on a sale to another country.
:::

## Autofill for State & Region Code

A message under **State Code (US)** or **Region Code (ISO 3166-2)** tells you the result.

::: tip Auto-filled based on State/Province.
The app found the code from the state. You do not need to do anything.
:::

::: warning Cannot find state code, please select from dropdown.
For a US address, the state is not a US state name. Select the code in **State Code (US)**.
:::

::: info Cannot find region code, using fallback code.
For an address outside the US, no region matches the state. The app uses `XX`, which TaxJar accepts. To send the correct region, correct the state or type the code.
:::

For an address outside the US, you can type a different region code. The app keeps your code when you change the state. For a US address, **State Code (US)** always changes with the state.

### Addresses Made Before the Install

When you install or update the app, it fills in the empty state codes and region codes of the addresses that are already on the site. It uses the same state names as the Address form, and it does not change a code that is already set.

If an address has no state, or a state that the app cannot find, its code stays empty. Open the address and select the code.

## Address in a Quick Entry

The **New Address** dialog and the **New Customer** quick entry work like the Address form:

- The country defaults to the one set in **System Settings**.
- As you type the state, the app fills in its state code or region code, just below State/Province.
- The address is optional in **New Customer** and **New Supplier**. Once you start typing Address Line 1 or City, both fields become required, along with the state code for a US address.

![The Primary Address Details of the New Customer quick entry with a US address, and State Code (US) filled in from the state](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/quick-entry-us-address.webp)

## Shipping Address Selection

:::tabs
== Select Shipping Address
**Opens when** the document has no shipping address, and the customer has addresses.

1. Select an address, and click **Use Selected**.
2. To use the address on later documents too, select **Use this address as shipping address for future transactions**.

If the address is not in the list, click **Add New Address**.

![The Select Shipping Address dialog with two customer addresses, the option to use the address on future transactions, and the Use Selected button](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/dialog-select-shipping.webp)
== Complete the Shipping Address
**Opens when** the ship-to address has no street, city, state, postal code or country.

Fill in the empty fields, and click **Continue**. The app saves the address, then the document.

![The Complete the Shipping Address dialog with the empty Postal Code field outlined in red](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/dialog-complete-shipping.webp)
== No Addresses Found
**Opens when** the customer has no address. A quotation saves without it.

Click **Add New Address**, and add a shipping address to the customer. The app then saves the document again.

![The No Addresses Found message with the Add New Address button](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/dialog-no-addresses.webp)
:::

## Company Address

Set it in [the Address step of TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#address). Select an address for each company, or click **Add address**, and wait for the green **Valid** badge.

When you save the step, the app sets **Preferred Billing Address** on the selected address, and clears it on the other addresses of the company. The tax calculation uses the address with this setting.

::: tip
You cannot delete or disable the only address of a TaxJar company. Add another address first.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/before-you-go-live

# Before you go live

The app has two API modes. Use Sandbox mode to test the setup, and Live mode to run your business.

| | Sandbox Mode | Live Mode |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| Current tax rates | | ● |
| TaxJar records the transactions for reports and AutoFile | | ● |
| API calls are free of your TaxJar plan quota | ● | |

The mode applies to all companies on the site. Each company has one Sandbox token and one Live token.

## Pre-requisites

- Copy the **Live** API token of each company from [TaxJar → Account → API Access](https://app.taxjar.com/account#api-access).
- You need to be a TaxJar Manager. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions).

::: warning Change the mode before you submit real invoices
An invoice that you submit in Sandbox mode goes to the TaxJar sandbox. It shows **Synced**, but it is not in your Live TaxJar account, and AutoFile does not file it.
:::

## Go Live

<ol class="steps">
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="change-the-mode">Change the mode</h3><span>Switch to Live, and connect each company with its Live token.</span></summary>

1. Open **TaxJar Setup** and click **Edit configuration**.
2. On the **Connect** step, in **API Mode**, click **Live**.
3. For each company, paste the Live token into **Live token**, then click **Connect**. Wait for the green **Connected** status.
4. Click **Save & continue** on each step, then click **Activate**.

::: info What the app does after you save
- It gets the nexus states again for each company.
- In Live mode, it sends to TaxJar each exempt customer that is not in TaxJar yet.
- If the site upgraded from TaxJar version 15, it starts the check of the older invoices. Refer to [Upgrade from Version 15](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/upgrade-from-version-15).
:::

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="check-the-result">Check the result</h3><span>Make sure that the setup is in Live mode, and test one invoice.</span></summary>

1. Open **TaxJar Setup**. The **Connection** card shows **API Mode** as **Live**.
2. Save a test sales invoice for a customer in a nexus state. Check that it has a **Sales Tax** row. Then delete the invoice.

</details></li>
</ol>

## Missing Live Token

A company that has no token for the current mode gets no tax, and its invoices do not sync. The sync error is:

> {company} has no Live API token, and TaxJar is in Live mode. Enter one in the guided setup.

1. Add the Live token of the company on the **Connect** step of TaxJar Setup.
2. The app sends the failed invoices again within 15 minutes. To send them at once, refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).

## Turn Off the App

To stop TaxJar for all companies:

1. Open **TaxJar API Settings**.
2. Clear **Enable TaxJar**, and save.

Then:

- The app calculates no tax and sends no transactions.
- It hides its parts on the forms.
- Invoices that you submit get the status **Excluded**.
- The TaxJar Sales Tax template is no longer the default template.
- The standard templates "US ST 6%", "US ST 4%" and "US ST 6.25%" stay disabled.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/tax-computation

# Tax Computation

When you save a quotation, a sales order, a sales invoice, a credit note or a debit note, the app gets the sales tax from TaxJar. You do not click a button, and any user who can save the document gets the tax.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  A[You save the document] --> B[The app sends the data to TaxJar]
  B --> C[TaxJar calculates the sales tax]
  C --> D[The app fills in the Sales Tax row]
```

If the data did not change since the last calculation, the app keeps the tax. Refer to [Recalculation Rules](#recalculation-rules).

## Quotes, Orders & Invoices

All five sales documents get sales tax when you save them. Only sales invoices, credit notes and debit notes go to TaxJar when you submit them. Refer to [Syncing to TaxJar](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/syncing-to-taxjar).

| Document | Tax on Save | Sent on Submit | Sent As |
|---|:-:|:-:|---|
| Quotation | ● | | - |
| Sales Order | ● | | - |
| Sales Invoice | ● | ● | TaxJar Order |
| Credit Note | ● | ● | TaxJar Refund |
| Debit Note | ● | ● | TaxJar Order |

## Parameters for Tax

| Data | Comes from |
|---|---|
| **Ship from** | The company address with **Preferred Billing Address** set. TaxJar Setup sets it. |
| **Ship to** | The **Shipping Address** of the document. If it is empty, the app asks for one when you save. |
| **Items** | The rate, the quantity and the discount of each item row. |
| **Product tax category** | The **Product Tax Category** of each item. Refer to [Item Tax Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/item-tax-exemption). |
| **Shipping** | The rows on the company's shipping ledger account. |
| **Other charges and discounts** | The other rows of the taxes table. Refer to [Additional Charges & Discounts](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/additional-charges-and-discounts). |
| **Exemption** | The exemption of the customer, or of the document. |
| **Currency** | A document in another currency is converted to USD with the ERPNext exchange rate. TaxJar's answer is converted back. |

## Taxability Checks

TaxJar charges sales tax only when all three answers are yes. The **TaxJar** tab of the document shows the three answers. Refer to [Verify Tax Applicability](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/verify-tax-applicability).

1. **Do you have nexus in the ship-to state?** If not, no tax.
2. **Is the customer taxable?** An exempt customer, or a sale marked as exempt, pays no tax.
3. **Is the product taxable?** The state may not tax the product tax category of an item.

The state also decides which address gives the rate:

| State type | Rate of |
|---|---|
| **Origin-based** | The ship-from address |
| **Destination-based** | The ship-to address |

## Skipped Calculations

In these cases, the app does not ask TaxJar. Every message and its fix is in [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors).

| Case | Result |
|---|---|
| **The ship-to country is not the United States** | An export. No US sales tax. |
| **The document has no address** | No tax. The form asks for an address. |
| **The company does not calculate tax** | No tax. **Compute Taxes on Sales** is off for the company in TaxJar Setup, or TaxJar is off for the site. |
| **TaxJar cannot be reached** | The document saves without new tax, with an orange message. Save it again later. |

## Recalculation Rules

The app keeps the sales tax, and does not ask TaxJar again, when all of these are true:

- The data that TaxJar uses did not change. Refer to [Parameters for Tax](#parameters-for-tax).
- The app calculated the tax in the current calendar month.
- Nobody saved TaxJar Setup after the calculation.
- The **Sales Tax** row still has the amount that TaxJar calculated.

This applies when you save a document again, and when you make a sales order from a quotation or an invoice from an order. The new document keeps the tax of the source document, so one sale needs only one request to TaxJar.

The app asks TaxJar again when one of these is not true, or when you invoice only a part of an order. For example, if you change the tax amount, or add a second row on the sales tax account, the app asks TaxJar again.

::: info Why a new month gets a new calculation
TaxJar always uses the rates of the day of the request, and most states and cities change rates on the first day of a month. In a new month, the app asks TaxJar again to get the current rates.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/verify-tax-applicability

# Verify Tax Applicability

Each saved quote, order and invoice shows how TaxJar arrived at its sales tax: why tax applies, which address sets the rate, and the tax for each jurisdiction.

::: tip
Save the document first. The tax and the breakdown show only after a save.
:::

::::tabs
== Tax Applicability Matrix
![The TaxJar tab of a Sales Invoice with the Ship From and Ship To addresses and the three cards of the Tax Applicability Matrix](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/document-tax-matrix.webp)

Open the document, and click the **TaxJar** tab.

**Ship From** and **Ship To** show the two addresses. The address that sets the rate has the label **(Origin based tax)** or **(Destination based tax)**.

| Card | Answer | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| **Do you have a nexus here?** | <Badge type="tip" text="Yes" /> | You have nexus in the ship-to state. |
|  | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | You have no nexus there, so there is no tax. |
| **Is the customer taxable?** | <Badge type="tip" text="Yes" /> | The customer pays sales tax. |
|  | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | The customer is exempt. |
|  | <Badge type="warning" text="Yes, but transaction is marked as exempt" /> | The customer pays tax, but this sale is exempt. |
| **Is the product taxable?** | <Badge type="tip" text="Yes" /> | All items are taxable. |
|  | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | No item is taxable. |
|  | <Badge type="warning" text="Partially" /> | Only some items are taxable. |

On the **Details** tab, below the totals, open **TaxJar Tax Breakdown**.

The table shows the rate and the tax for the state, the county, the city and each special district. **Are shipping charges taxable?** shows whether the state taxes shipping.
== Missing or Wrong Tax
![The TaxJar Tax Breakdown section of an exempt invoice with the reason that no tax is charged](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/document-no-tax-reason.webp)

When TaxJar charged no tax, **TaxJar Tax Breakdown** shows the reason in place of the table.

| Reason on the form | Cause |
|---|---|
| Wholesale customer is exempted from taxes, hence no taxes are charged. | The customer has a Wholesale exemption for the ship-to state. Government and Other show the same type of sentence. |
| Wholesale transaction is exempted from taxes, hence no taxes are charged. | The document is marked as exempt with the reason Wholesale. |
| None of the items are taxable in {ship-to}, hence no taxes are charged. | The state does not tax any item on the document. |
| No sales tax applies in {ship-to}, hence no taxes are charged. | TaxJar returned no tax for another reason. |

For other causes, refer to [Missing Sales Tax](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/missing-sales-tax).
::::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/additional-charges-and-discounts

# Additional Charges & Discounts

TaxJar needs to know which amounts are shipping, which are other charges, and which are discounts. Some states tax shipping, and a discount lowers the taxable amount.

## Charges and discounts

::::tabs
== Shipping
Enter the shipping amount in the **Shipping & Forwarding Charges** row of the taxes table. TaxJar Setup adds this row, on the shipping ledger of the company, to the TaxJar tax template.

![The Sales Taxes and Charges table with the shipping row on the Shipping and Freight Income ledger and the Sales Tax row](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/shipping-row.webp)

When you save, TaxJar decides if the state taxes the shipping. **TaxJar Tax Breakdown** shows the answer in **Are shipping charges taxable?**.

![The TaxJar Tax Breakdown heading with Are shipping charges taxable? set to No](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/shipping-taxable.webp)
== Other Charges
![The Confirm Tax Treatment for Extra Charges dialog with one row that increases the taxable value and one row that decreases it](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/dialog-extra-charges.webp)

When the taxes table has a row on another ledger, the dialog **Confirm Tax Treatment for Extra Charges** opens when you save.

| Row Amount | Type | Sent to TaxJar As |
|---|---|---|
| **Positive**, for example a handling fee | <Badge type="tip" text="Increases Taxable Value" /> | A taxed line named `[OTHER] {ledger name}` |
| **Negative**, for example a rebate | <Badge type="warning" text="Decreases Taxable Value" /> | A discount, spread over the item lines |

Click **Proceed** to save. To change the rows first, click **Cancel**.
== Discounts
- **On the whole document:** use **Additional Discount**, not a negative row in the taxes table. The app sends each item's share to TaxJar as a line discount.
- **On one item:** use the **Discount** of that item row.

![The Additional Discount section with a 10% discount on the Grand Total](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/additional-discount.webp)

::: info Cash or non-trade discount
ERPNext takes it off after the tax, so TaxJar calculates the tax on the amount before the discount.
:::
::::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/print-format

# Print Format

The app adds three print formats with the TaxJar tax details:

| Document | Print format |
|---|---|
| Quotation | **US Sales Tax Quotation** |
| Sales Order | **US Sales Tax Sales Order** |
| Sales Invoice, credit note and debit note | **US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN)** |

Each format becomes the default print format of its document, and **US Company Letter Head** the default letter head, when none is set.

## Print a Document

1. Open the quotation, sales order, sales invoice, credit note or debit note.
2. Click the print icon.
3. In **Print Format**, select the US Sales Tax format of the document.
4. Click **Print** or **PDF**.

## What the Format Shows

:::tabs
== Quotation
![A Quotation printed in the US Sales Tax Quotation format with the Valid Till date, the Tax Analysis table, the totals and the Terms and Conditions as a list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/print-us-sales-tax-quotation.webp)
== Sales Order
![A Sales Order printed in the US Sales Tax Sales Order format with the Delivery Date, the Tax Analysis table, the totals and the Terms and Conditions as a list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/print-us-sales-tax-sales-order.webp)
== Sales Invoice
![A Sales Invoice printed in the US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN) format with the Tax Analysis table, the totals, In Words and the Terms and Conditions as a list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/print-us-sales-tax-invoice-bullets.webp)
== Credit Note
![A Credit Note printed in the US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN) format with the Sales invoice Ref., the negative amounts, the negative tax for each jurisdiction and the Terms and Conditions as a list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/print-us-sales-tax-credit-note-terms.webp)
== Debit Note
![A Debit Note printed in the US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN) format with the Sales invoice Ref., the extra amount, its tax for each jurisdiction and the Terms and Conditions as a list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/print-us-sales-tax-debit-note-terms.webp)
:::

| Part | Shows |
|---|---|
| **Title** | The document type, for example **Quotation** or **Credit Note**, with its number. For an export, **EXPORT** shows below the title. |
| **Dates** | **Date**, and **Valid Till** on a quotation, **Delivery Date** on a sales order, or **Due Date** on an invoice. |
| **References** | **Sales invoice Ref.**, the original invoice of a credit note or a debit note. **Purchase Order No.**, when the document has one. |
| **Addresses** | **Ship From**, **Bill To** and **Ship To**, with the company Tax ID and the customer Tax ID. |
| **Items** | The item description below the item name, when it is different from the name. |
| **Tax Analysis** | The tax for each jurisdiction, and the tax status line, for example "Destination-based tax for {ship-to}". With no tax, it shows "Taxes are not applicable". |
| **Totals** | A **Discount** row above **Grand Total**, for a cash or non-trade discount. A trade discount shows in the item **Discount** column. **In Words** shows below **Grand Total**. |
| **Terms and Conditions** | Below the totals, when the document has terms. |

## Build Your Own Format

To change the layout, make your own format from a copy of the app's format:

1. Open the **Print Format** list, and open the US Sales Tax format of the document.
2. In the menu, click **Duplicate**, and give the copy a new name.
3. Change the HTML of the copy.
4. To print with the copy by default, set it as **Default Print Format** of the document in **Customize Form**.

Quotations, sales orders and sales invoices have the same TaxJar fields. The copy can use these fields of the document:

| Field | Holds |
|---|---|
| `doc.taxjar_breakdown_html` | The jurisdiction table. The app fills it in when you print. |
| `doc.taxjar_tax_source` | `origin` or `destination`: the address that sets the rate. |
| `doc.taxjar_ship_to` | The ship-to address that TaxJar used. |
| `doc.taxjar_has_nexus` | `1` when the company has nexus in the ship-to state. |
| `doc.taxjar_customer_taxable` | `0` when the customer is exempt. |
| `doc.taxjar_transaction_exempt` | `1` when the sale is marked as exempt. |
| `doc.taxjar_freight_taxable` | `1` when the state taxes the shipping. |

::: info App updates
App updates change only the app's own format. Your copy keeps your changes, but it does not get the updates of the app's format.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/syncing-to-taxjar

# Syncing to TaxJar

TaxJar AutoFile files your returns from the transactions in your TaxJar account. When you submit a sales invoice, a credit note or a debit note, the app sends it to TaxJar. This is the **sync**.

Quotations and sales orders get sales tax, but the app does not send them to TaxJar. Refer to [Tax Computation](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/tax-computation).

## Pre-requisites

- The company has **Sync Transactions to TaxJar** on. Refer to [the Features step of TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#features).
- The invoice has a **Shipping Address** or a **Billing Address**. Without one, the app does not let you submit.

## What Syncs to TaxJar

| Action in ERPNext | Result in TaxJar |
|---|---|
| **Save a draft** | Nothing. TaxJar gets only submitted documents. |
| **Submit a sales invoice** | <Badge type="tip" text="TaxJar Order" /> |
| **Submit a debit note** | <Badge type="tip" text="TaxJar Order" /> |
| **Submit a credit note** | <Badge type="warning" text="TaxJar Refund" /> against the original invoice |
| **Cancel a document** | <Badge type="danger" text="Deleted" /> The app deletes the order or the refund. |
| **Amend a cancelled invoice and submit it** | <Badge type="tip" text="TaxJar Order" /> A new order, with its own number. |

TaxJar records the transaction on the **Posting Date**, and the invoice number is the transaction ID in TaxJar.

::: info A credit note needs its original invoice
TaxJar records a refund against the original order. So a credit note must name its original invoice, and that invoice must be in TaxJar. Refer to [Credit notes](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/credit-and-debit-notes#credit-note).
:::

## Track the Sync

1. Open the draft sales invoice.
2. Click **Submit**, then confirm.

The app sends the invoice in the background. You can see the result in three places:

:::tabs
== Sidebar Status
The sidebar shows **TaxJar Status**. Hover over the status to see when the app sent the invoice.

![A submitted Sales Invoice with TaxJar Status Synced in the sidebar, and its hover card Synced 10 minutes ago](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-sync-status-hover.webp)
== Transaction Sync
The **TaxJar** tab of the invoice has a **Transaction Sync** section with the details.

![The Transaction Sync section of the TaxJar tab with Sync Status Synced and the Last Synced time](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-sync-section.webp)

| Field | Shows |
|---|---|
| **Sync Status** | Excluded, Queued, Synced or Failed. Refer to [Sync Statuses](#sync-statuses). |
| **Sync Error** | The cause of a failure. It shows only for Failed. |
| **Exclusion Reason** | Why the app did not send the invoice. It shows only for Excluded. |
| **Last Synced** | The time of the last successful sync. A later failure does not clear it. |
== Transaction Sync Page
In the TaxJar sidebar, click **TaxJar Transaction Sync**. The page counts the invoices, credit notes and debit notes of each status, and lists them with filters. Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).

![The TaxJar Transaction Sync page with the filters, the counts of failed, queued, synced, draft and excluded transactions, and the table with the sync status of each transaction](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/transaction-sync-page.webp)
:::

## Sync Outcomes

:::tabs
== Synced
When you submit, the status changes to <Badge type="info" text="Queued" />. In less than a minute, it usually changes to <Badge type="tip" text="Synced" />. Nothing else to do.
== Excluded
The app did not send the invoice, and the status is <Badge type="info" text="Excluded" />, with a reason. For example:

- the company has **Domestic only** selected, and the invoice is an export;
- sync was not on for the company, or TaxJar was off, when you submitted the invoice;
- the invoice is from TaxJar version 15, and waits for the upgrade check.

All reasons are in [Sync Statuses](#sync-statuses), in the **Exclusion Reasons** tab.
== Failed
TaxJar did not accept the invoice. The status is <Badge type="danger" text="Failed" />, and the **Sync Error** gives the cause.

| Error | Example | What happens |
|---|---|---|
| **Temporary** | TaxJar is offline, or the rate limit is reached. | The error ends with "Automatic retry is scheduled." The app tries again every 15 minutes, up to five times. |
| **In the data** | An address that TaxJar cannot find. | Fix the data, then [send the invoice again](#resync-an-invoice). |

Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).
:::

## Resync an Invoice

Use this for an invoice with the status **Failed** or **Excluded**.

1. Fix the cause. The **Sync Error** or the **Exclusion Reason** tells you what to fix. Refer to [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors#sync-errors).
2. Click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**.
3. Wait for the message "Sync complete".

The button does not show for an export that the company does not send, or for a version 15 invoice that waits for the upgrade check. To send many failed invoices at one time, use [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).

## Sync Statuses

The sync status tells you whether a document is in TaxJar. It shows as **TaxJar Status** in the sidebar of the form, as **Sync Status** on the TaxJar tab, and in the TaxJar Transaction Sync page.

:::tabs
== Invoice Statuses
| Status | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| **Submit to Sync** | The document is a draft. | Submit it to send it. |
| **Queued** | The app sends the document now. | Wait. It usually takes less than one minute. |
| **Synced** | The document is in TaxJar. Hover to see when it was sent. | Nothing. |
| **Failed** | TaxJar did not accept the document. Hover to read the error. | Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs). |
| **Excluded** | The app did not send the document. Hover to read the reason. | Check the reason in the **Exclusion Reasons** tab. |
| **Cancelled** | You cancelled the document, and the app deleted it from TaxJar. | Nothing. |
| **Failed to Cancel** | You cancelled the document, but the app could not delete it from TaxJar. | [Fix the cancellation](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/cancellations-and-amendments#failed-cancellation). |

The **Cancelled** label shows on the form. On the TaxJar Transaction Sync page, a cancelled document that TaxJar no longer holds shows as **Synced**, with the transaction status **Cancelled**.
== Exclusion Reasons
| Reason | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| TaxJar was switched off for this site when this document was submitted. | **Enable TaxJar** was off. | Turn it on, then [send the invoice](#resync-an-invoice). |
| Transaction sync was not enabled for this company when this document was submitted. | **Sync Transactions to TaxJar** was off. | Turn it on, then send the invoice. |
| Export transactions sync is disabled. | The company sends domestic sales only, and this is an export. | Nothing, if this is correct. To send exports, select **Domestic + Export** in TaxJar Setup. |
| …submitted before the upgrade from TaxJar version 15. The check of whether TaxJar holds it has not run yet. | A version 15 invoice. | Click **Run the check**. Refer to [Upgrade from Version 15](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/upgrade-from-version-15). |
| …submitted before the upgrade from TaxJar version 15. TaxJar does not hold it. | The check found that TaxJar does not hold it. | If it must be in TaxJar, click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**. |
| This transaction was removed from TaxJar. | Only invoices from older versions of the app show this. | Nothing. |

In the export of the TaxJar Transaction Sync page, a reason that the app found from the current settings has the suffix "(current setting)".
== Customer Sync Statuses
| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **NA** | The customer has no exemption to send. |
| **Queued** | The app sends the customer now. |
| **Synced** | The customer is in TaxJar. |
| **Failed** | TaxJar did not accept the customer. **TaxJar Sync Error** gives the cause. |
| **Not Sent** | The customer waited in the queue for more than 15 minutes. Resync it. |
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs

# Resolve Failed Syncs

When an invoice or a customer exemption does not reach TaxJar, find it, fix the cause and send it again.

## Resolve a failed sync

::::tabs
== Failed
![The Failed tab of the TaxJar Transaction Sync page with the error popover of one failed invoice](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/sync-failed-popover.webp)

1. In the TaxJar sidebar, click **TaxJar Transaction Sync**, and click the **Failed** tab.
2. Hover over the information icon in **Sync Status** to read the error. Find it in [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors#sync-errors).
3. Fix the cause, select the rows, and click **Resync**.

The rows change to **Queued**, then to **Synced**.

::: tip Temporary errors fix themselves
An error that ends with "Automatic retry is scheduled." is temporary. The app tries again every 15 minutes, up to five times.
:::
== Excluded
**Resync** sends only failed transactions. To send an **Excluded** invoice:

1. Fix the reason, for example turn on sync for the company.
2. Open the invoice, and click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**.
== Stuck in Queued
A transaction is usually Queued for less than one minute. If it stays Queued for more than 15 minutes, the background jobs of the server can be stopped. Ask your system administrator to check the background workers.
== Customers
1. On **Customer Tax Exemption**, click **Failed** in the summary strip.
2. Hover over the information icon in **Sync Status** to read the error. Find it in [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors#customer-messages).
3. Fix the cause, select the rows, and click **Bulk Action** → **Resync with TaxJar**.

The app also tries a failed customer again every 15 minutes, up to five times. A customer with **Not Sent** waited too long in the queue. Resync it.
::::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/credit-and-debit-notes

# Credit & Debit Notes

A credit note gives money back on an earlier sales invoice, and a debit note charges more on it. In ERPNext, both are sales invoices: they get sales tax when you save them, and go to TaxJar when you submit them.

| | Credit Note | Debit Note |
|---|---|---|
| **Use it to** | Give money back, for example for a return | Charge more, for example after a price increase |
| **In TaxJar** | <Badge type="warning" text="TaxJar Refund" /> against the original invoice | <Badge type="tip" text="TaxJar Order" /> a new order |
| **Original invoice** | Must be **Synced** first | No rule |

## Credit Note

TaxJar records a credit note as a refund of the original invoice, so you always make the credit note from the original invoice.

::: tip
The original invoice must have the TaxJar status **Synced**. If it is **Failed** or **Excluded**, [send it to TaxJar](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/syncing-to-taxjar#resync-an-invoice) first.
:::

::::tabs
== From the Invoice
1. Open the original sales invoice.
2. Click **Create** → **Return / Credit Note**.
3. Change the items and the quantities to the returned values.
4. Save and submit the credit note.

The app sends the credit note to TaxJar as a refund.

![A submitted Sales Invoice with the Create menu open and Return / Credit Note in the list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/credit-note-create-menu.webp)
== From a New Invoice
If you select **Is Return (Credit Note)** on a new sales invoice, the dialog **Credit Note Against Invoice** opens.

![A new Sales Invoice with Is Return (Credit Note) selected in the Details tab](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/new-invoice-is-return.webp)

1. Select the **Customer**.
2. Select the original **Sales Invoice**. The preview shows its **Sync Status**, which must be **Synced**.
3. Click **Continue**.

The app opens a new credit note against that invoice. If you close the dialog, the app clears **Is Return (Credit Note)**.

![The Credit Note Against Invoice dialog with a synced invoice selected and its preview](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/dialog-credit-note-against-invoice.webp)
== Errors
The app stops the credit note with one of these messages.

::: warning Original Invoice Not Synced
The original invoice is not in TaxJar. Send the original invoice to TaxJar, then submit the credit note.
:::

::: warning TaxJar: Missing Return Reference
The credit note does not name its original invoice. Make it from the original invoice with **Create** → **Return / Credit Note**.
:::

::: warning {customer} has no submitted invoice.
The customer has no invoice to credit. Submit an invoice for the customer first.
:::
== Exports
If the company sends domestic sales only, an export invoice is **Excluded**. You can make a credit note for it. The credit note is also **Excluded**, and nothing goes to TaxJar.
::::

## Debit Note

A debit note adds an amount to an earlier sales invoice. In ERPNext, it is a sales invoice with **Is Rate Adjustment Entry (Debit Note)** set. The app treats it like a sales invoice:

- When you save it, TaxJar calculates the sales tax on the added amount.
- When you submit it, the app sends it to TaxJar as a new order. The original invoice in TaxJar does not change.

:::tabs
== Make the Debit Note
1. Make a new **Sales Invoice** for the same company and customer as the original invoice.
2. Select **Is Rate Adjustment Entry (Debit Note)**.
3. In **Return Against**, select the original invoice. After you save, ERPNext shows this field as **Adjustment Against**.
4. In the items table, enter the added amount as the rate of each item.
5. Save the debit note, and check the **Sales Tax** row in the taxes table.
6. Submit the debit note.

![A new Sales Invoice with Is Rate Adjustment Entry (Debit Note) selected and the original invoice in Return Against](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/new-invoice-debit-note.webp)
== Check the Sync
Open the **TaxJar** tab of the debit note. **TaxJar Sync Status** shows **Queued**, then **Synced**, usually in less than a minute. If it shows **Failed**, refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).

On the **TaxJar Transaction Sync** page, filter by the transaction type **Debit Note** to see all debit notes.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/cancellations-and-amendments

# Cancellations & Amendments

A submitted invoice is in TaxJar, so how you correct it depends on whether TaxJar already filed its period.

## Correct an Invoice

::::tabs
== Period Not Filed
The invoice is in the current period, and TaxJar has not filed it yet. Cancel and amend the invoice, or make a [credit note](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/credit-and-debit-notes#credit-note).

To cancel and amend the invoice:

1. Open the submitted invoice.
2. Click **Cancel**, then confirm. The app deletes the transaction from TaxJar in the background, and the TaxJar status changes to <Badge type="info" text="Cancelled" />.
3. Click **Amend**, change what you need, and submit the new invoice. The app sends it to TaxJar as a new transaction.
== Period Filed
TaxJar already filed the period of the invoice. Make a [credit note](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/credit-and-debit-notes#credit-note) in the current period.

::: danger Do not cancel an invoice of a filed period
When you cancel an invoice, the app deletes the transaction from TaxJar. This changes the data of a period that is already filed.
:::
::::

::: warning Do not change the posting date of a synced invoice
TaxJar records the transaction on the posting date, so a new date moves the sale to another period.
:::

## Failed Cancellation

If the status is <Badge type="danger" text="Failed to Cancel" />, the app could not delete the transaction, and it is still in TaxJar.

1. Read the **Sync Error** on the **TaxJar** tab, and fix the cause.
2. Click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**, or use **Resync** on the **TaxJar Transaction Sync** page. Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs).

::: info Temporary errors
For a temporary error, the app also tries again every 15 minutes, up to five times.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption

# Customer Tax Exemption

Set an exemption on customers who do not pay sales tax, for example resellers and government agencies. TaxJar then charges no tax to that customer in the exempt states.

## Pre-requisites

- You need **Sales User** in addition to your TaxJar roles. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions).
- Get the exemption certificate from the customer, and keep it. TaxJar and the app do not store certificates.

## Exemption Types

| Exemption type | Use it for |
|---|---|
| **Wholesale** | Buyers who resell the goods. |
| **Government** | Government agencies. |
| **Other** | Other exempt buyers, for example non-profit organizations. |
| **Non Exempt** | Customers who pay tax in all states. |

Wholesale, Government and Other need **exempt regions**: the US states and Canadian provinces where the exemption applies. The exemption applies only when the ship-to address is in one of these regions. To exempt a customer everywhere, click **Select All**.

## Single Exemption

::::tabs
== Open the Customer
Open the **Customer**, and go to the **Tax** tab. The **TaxJar Tax Exemption** section shows the current exemption.

![The Tax tab of a customer with the TaxJar Tax Exemption section, Non-Exempted, and the edit icon](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customer-tax-tab.webp)
== Set the Exemption
1. In **TaxJar Tax Exemption**, click the edit icon (**Manage Exemption**).
2. Select the **Exemption Type**, and the regions in **US States** and **CA Provinces**.
3. Click **Apply**.

![The Manage Exemption dialog with the type Wholesale, Arizona and California selected, and the CA Provinces list](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customer-manage-exemption-full.webp)
== Exemption Applied
The section shows the type and the exempt regions, and the app sends the exemption to TaxJar. **TaxJar Sync Details** shows **TaxJar Sync Status** as **Synced**.

![The Tax tab of an exempt customer with Exempted Wholesale, two US states, two Canadian provinces, and TaxJar Sync Status Synced](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customer-exemption-applied.webp)
::::

## Bulk Exemption

::::tabs
== Set the Exemption
1. In the TaxJar sidebar, click **Customer Tax Exemption**.
2. Select the customers. Use the tabs or the filters to find them.
3. Click **Bulk Action** → **Configure Exemption…**.
4. Select the **Exemption Type** and the regions, and click **Apply**.

::: warning Apply replaces the regions
**Apply** replaces the exempt regions of every selected customer.
:::

![The TaxJar Customer Configuration page with the summary strip, the tabs, two selected rows and the Bulk Action menu open](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customers-page.webp)
== Clear the Exemption
Select the customers, and click **Bulk Action** → **Clear Exemption**. The app removes the exemption type and the exempt regions of each customer, and sends the change to TaxJar.

![The TaxJar Customer Configuration page with two customers selected and the Bulk Action menu open on Clear Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customers-clear-exemption.webp)
== Export the List
Click **Export** to get the customer list as an Excel file.

![The TaxJar Customer Configuration page with the Export button next to Bulk Action](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/customers-export.webp)
::::

If a customer shows **Failed**, refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs#resolve-a-failed-sync), in the **Customers** tab.

## Multi-Company Customers

The app sends the customer to the TaxJar account of each TaxJar company.

To send one customer to one company again:

1. Open the customer, and click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**.
2. If the customer belongs to more than one company, select the **Company** in the dialog, and click **Sync**.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/transaction-tax-exemption

# Transaction Tax Exemption

Use this when one sale is exempt, but the customer usually pays tax. For a customer who is always exempt, [exempt the customer](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption) instead.

::: tip
Get the exemption certificate for this sale from the customer, and keep it. TaxJar and the app do not store certificates.
:::

## Mark a Sale as Exempt

1. Open the quotation, sales order or sales invoice.
2. Below the totals, in **TaxJar Exemptions**, select **Is transaction exempt from sales tax?**.
3. In **Reason for exemption?**, select **Wholesale**, **Government** or **Other**.
4. Save the document.

:::tabs
== Exemption Fields
The **TaxJar Exemptions** section is on the **Details** tab, below the items and the totals.

![A draft Sales Invoice scrolled to the items, the total and the TaxJar Exemptions section with Is transaction exempt from sales tax? selected and the reason Wholesale](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-transaction-exempt-section.webp)
== Result
The document has no sales tax. On the **TaxJar** tab, **Is the customer taxable?** shows **Yes, but transaction is marked as exempt**.

![The TaxJar tab of the invoice with the Tax Applicability Matrix, and Is the customer taxable? showing Yes, but transaction is marked as exempt](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/invoice-transaction-exempt-result.webp)
:::

## Locked Fields

- If the customer has an exemption for the ship-to state, the app fills in these fields and locks them.
- For an export, the app sets the reason to **Other**.

::: warning Exempt sales cannot have sales tax
If the document has a sales tax amount and is marked as exempt, TaxJar does not accept the invoice. Clear the exemption, or remove the sales tax row.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/item-tax-exemption

# Item Tax Exemption

A product tax category tells TaxJar how each state taxes an item. For example, some states do not tax clothing or food. An item with no category is taxed as general goods.

::: tip
To set the category on items, you need the **Item Manager** role. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions).
:::

## Find a Category

Find the category in the [TaxJar product tax codes](https://developers.taxjar.com/api/reference/#categories), or in the app:

1. In the TaxJar sidebar, click **Nexus & Product Category**.
2. In **Product Tax Category**, click **{n} categories configured**.

![The Manage nexus & product category page with the nexus states of one company, Arizona and New York, and 870 product tax categories, each with its sync time and a refresh button](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/nexus-page.webp)

## Set the Category on an Item

1. Open the **Item**.
2. In **Product Tax Category**, below **Item Group**, select the category.
3. Save the item.

![The Item form with the Product Tax Category list open below Item Group, filtered to clothing categories](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/item-form-product-tax-category.webp)

::: warning Set the category before you sell
A document keeps the category that the item had when you added it. A later change on the item does not change that document.
:::

## Update the Categories

The app gets new categories from TaxJar each week. To get them now:

1. Open **Nexus & Product Category**.
2. In **Product Tax Category**, click the refresh icon.
3. Wait for the message "Product tax categories fetched and updated."

::: info
Only a TaxJar Manager sees the refresh icon. The app adds new categories, and does not change your own.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-return-filing/period-close-and-filing

# Period Close & Filing

TaxJar AutoFile files your return from the transactions in your TaxJar account. An invoice that is not in TaxJar is not on the return. So before each deadline, you check the period in ERPNext, then in TaxJar.

The app does not file returns, and it does not show the filing status.

::: tip
Sync must be on for the company, in **Live** mode. Refer to [Before you go live](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/before-you-go-live). You need the TaxJar User roles. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions).
:::

## Close the Period

<ol class="steps">
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="check-the-period-in-erpnext">Check the period in ERPNext</h3><span>Make sure that every invoice of the period is in TaxJar.</span></summary>

::::tabs
== Open the Period
1. In the TaxJar sidebar, click **TaxJar Transaction Sync**.
2. In **Company**, select the company.
