3. In **From Date** and **To Date**, enter the first and the last day of the filing period. The dates filter on the **Posting Date**, the same date that TaxJar uses.
4. Keep **Transaction Type** and **Nature** on **All**.

![The TaxJar Transaction Sync page with the filters, the summary strip, the tabs and the table](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/sync-page.webp)
== Read the Summary
![The summary strip of the TaxJar Transaction Sync page with one Failed transaction](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/sync-summary-strip.webp)

| Card | Meaning | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| <Badge type="danger" text="Failed" /> | TaxJar did not accept the transaction. | Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs). |
| <Badge type="info" text="Queued" /> | The app sends the transaction now. | Wait a few minutes, then check again. |
| <Badge type="tip" text="Synced" /> | The transaction is in TaxJar. | Nothing. |
| <Badge type="warning" text="Draft" /> | The document is not submitted. | Submit it or delete it. |
| <Badge type="info" text="Excluded" /> | The app did not send the transaction. | Hover over the information icon, and make sure that the reason is correct. |
== Ready Check
::: tip The period is ready when
- **Failed** is 0.
- **Queued** is 0.
- **Draft** is 0, or the drafts are not real sales.
- Each **Excluded** transaction has a correct reason.
- In **Transaction Type**, **Credit Note** shows only **Synced** credit notes.
:::
== Keep a Record
1. Click the **All Transactions** tab.
2. Click **Export**.

The Excel file has one row for each transaction, with its status, its error and its last sync time. One export has up to 10,000 rows. For more, use a shorter date range.
::::

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="file-the-return-in-taxjar">File the return in TaxJar</h3><span>Compare the totals, and let AutoFile file the return.</span></summary>

Do these tasks in your TaxJar account.

::::tabs
== Turn On AutoFile
Make sure that AutoFile is on for each state where you file.

::: info
TaxJar's help article [How does AutoFile work?](https://support.taxjar.com/article/908-how-does-autofile-work) gives the full procedure.
:::
== Compare the Totals
Open the sales tax report in TaxJar for the state and the period. Then open the **Sales Register** report in ERPNext with the same company and dates, and compare:

| In TaxJar | In ERPNext Sales Register |
|---|---|
| **Total sales** | The net total of the invoices |
| **Sales tax** | The column of your Sales Tax Ledger Account |

::: warning If the totals are not the same
Go back to [Check the period in ERPNext](#check-the-period-in-erpnext), and find the transaction that is not in TaxJar.
:::
== File the Return
Let AutoFile file the return before the deadline. The app does not file returns, and it does not show the filing status.
::::

</details></li>
</ol>

## After the Return Is Filed

::: danger Do not change a filed period
- Do not cancel or amend the invoices of a filed period. Make a credit note in the current period. Refer to [Cancellations & Amendments](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/cancellations-and-amendments).
- Do not change the posting date of a synced invoice.
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/missing-sales-tax

# Missing Sales Tax

When a quotation, sales order or sales invoice has no sales tax, the form or the **TaxJar** tab tells you why.

## Find the Cause

1. Save the document.
2. Look at the top of the form. A message there gives the cause for the three most common cases.
3. If there is no message, open the **TaxJar** tab, and read the three cards of the **Tax Applicability Matrix**.

::::tabs
== Form Message
| Message | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| "Customer address is not set, hence taxes are not calculated." | The document has no address. | Click **Create Address →**, or select a **Shipping Address**. |
| "Nexus not configured for {state}, hence no taxes are charged." | You have no nexus in the ship-to state. | If you must collect tax there, add the state in TaxJar. Then [sync the nexus](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus#on-demand-nexus-sync). |
| "Sales taxes are not applicable on export transactions." | The ship-to country is not the United States. | Nothing. Exports have no US sales tax. |
| "TaxJar API is unreachable. Tax has not been calculated for this document." (orange) | TaxJar did not answer. | Wait, then save the document again. |
== TaxJar Tab
| Card | Answer | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Do you have a nexus here?** | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | You have no nexus in the ship-to state. | Add the state in TaxJar, then [sync the nexus](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus#on-demand-nexus-sync). |
| **Is the customer taxable?** | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | The customer is exempt in the ship-to state. | Check the exemption of the customer. Refer to [Customer Tax Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption). |
| | <Badge type="warning" text="Yes, but transaction is marked as exempt" /> | The document is marked as exempt. | Clear **Is transaction exempt from sales tax?**. |
| **Is the product taxable?** | <Badge type="danger" text="No" /> | The state does not tax the items. | Check the **Product Tax Category** of each item. |
== No Message
If there is no message, and the **TaxJar** tab is not there, the company does not calculate tax.

1. In [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#features), turn on **Compute Taxes on Sales** for the company.
2. Make sure that **Enable TaxJar** is on.
::::

## Wrong Tax Amount

If the tax is there but looks wrong, check these:

- The **Ship From** and **Ship To** addresses on the **TaxJar** tab. A wrong postal code gives a wrong rate. Refer to [Address Validation](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/address-validation).
- The product tax categories of the items.
- The tax for each jurisdiction, in [TaxJar Tax Breakdown](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/verify-tax-applicability).

::: tip
If you changed the items, the address or the shipping, save the document again. If the save stops with a message, find it in [Messages & Errors](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors).
:::

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/messages-and-errors

# Messages & Errors

Each section lists the messages of one place in the app, with the cause and the fix.

::: tip
Find a message with the search (Ctrl+K or ⌘K). Text in braces, for example {company}, is a name that changes.
:::

## Setup Messages

These show in TaxJar Setup and on the TaxJar Settings form.

| Message | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Invalid token (401). Check you copied the Live token. | The token is wrong, or it is for the other mode. | Copy the token again from TaxJar, for the correct mode. Click **Connect**. |
| Could not reach TaxJar. Check your connection and try again. | The server cannot reach TaxJar. | Check the internet connection of the server, then click **Retry**. |
| Please validate API Key for {company}. | The company is not connected. | Click **Connect** for that company before you continue. |
| Invalid address as per TaxJar. | TaxJar cannot find the company address. | Correct the address, then check it again. |
| At least one Live Token is required in API Credentials for Live mode. | Live mode is on, but no company has a Live token. | Add a Live token. The Sandbox message is the same for Sandbox mode. |

## Save Messages

These show on a quotation, a sales order or a sales invoice.

| Message | Cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Customer address is not set, hence taxes are not calculated. | The document has no address. | Click **Create Address →**, or select an address. |
| Nexus not configured for {state}, hence no taxes are charged. | You have no nexus in the ship-to state. | If you must collect tax there, add the state in TaxJar, then [sync the nexus](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus#on-demand-nexus-sync). |
| Sales taxes are not applicable on export transactions. | The ship-to country is not the United States. | Nothing. |
| Company Address Required: Please set a default address for the company {company}. | The company has no address. | Add a company address in [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#address). |
| Exchange Rate Not Found: Could not find exchange rate from {currency} to USD for {date}. | The document is not in USD, and ERPNext has no rate. | Add a **Currency Exchange** record to USD, or set up **Currency Exchange Settings**. |
| TaxJar API is unreachable. Tax has not been calculated for this document. | TaxJar did not answer. The document saved without new tax. | Wait, then save again. |
| TaxJar Tax Calculation Failed | TaxJar did not accept the data. | Read the message. If it names an address, correct that address. |
| Address Required: No Shipping Address or Billing Address is set on this transaction. | The document has no address. | Add an address to the customer, and select it on the document. |
| No Addresses Found | The customer has no address. | Add a shipping address to the customer. |
| Destination Required to File | You submit an invoice with no address, for a company that syncs. | Set a **Shipping Address** or a **Billing Address**, then submit. |

## Address Messages

These show when you save an address.

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| State Required | Fill in **State/Province**. |
| State Code Required | Fill in **State Code (US)**. |
| Postal Code Required | Fill in **Postal Code**. |
| Company Address Required: {address} is the only address {company} has… | Add another address for the company before you delete or disable this one. |

## Sync Errors

These show as the **Sync Error** of an invoice or a credit note. An error that ends with "Automatic retry is scheduled." is temporary. The app tries again every 15 minutes, up to five times.

| Error | Fix |
|---|---|
| TaxJar API Token is invalid, go to guided setup to configure. | Enter a correct token in [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#connect), then resync. |
| {company} has no {mode} API token, and TaxJar is in {mode} mode. Enter one in the guided setup. | Enter the token for the current mode. The app then sends the invoice again within 15 minutes. |
| TaxJar is not configured for {company}. Add its API credential in the guided setup. | Connect the company in TaxJar Setup. |
| Transaction ID already exists in TaxJar, please cancel & create a new transaction. | Cancel the invoice, amend it, and submit the new invoice. |
| Exempt transactions cannot have sales tax, please clear exemption or remove sales tax. | Clear the exemption, or remove the sales tax row. |
| Transaction not found in TaxJar, can't update the latest changes. | The transaction is not in TaxJar. Check the [API Log](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/api-log). |
| TaxJar could not process the request: {detail}. | Read the detail. The [API Log](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/api-log) shows the request that TaxJar refused. |
| TaxJar rejected the request as malformed: {detail}. | Read the detail, and correct the field that it names. |
| This TaxJar account is not allowed to make that request | Make sure that your TaxJar plan includes the API. |
| TaxJar's API rate limit was reached | Nothing. The app tries again. |
| TaxJar is unreachable - the request timed out or the connection failed. | Nothing. The app tries again. |
| TaxJar is temporarily unreachable, TaxJar is temporarily offline for maintenance, TaxJar took too long to respond, or TaxJar hit an internal server error | Nothing. The app tries again. |
| TaxJar returned a response that could not be read… | Nothing. It is usually a short outage at TaxJar. The app tries again. |
| No TaxJar payload could be built for this document - check the company's TaxJar configuration. | Check the company in TaxJar Setup. The app tries again. |

### Sync Button Messages

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| Invoice Not Submitted | Submit the invoice first. |
| Check Before You Sync | The invoice is from version 15. Run the [upgrade check](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/upgrade-from-version-15#check-older-invoices) first. |
| Filing Is Off | Turn on **Sync Transactions to TaxJar** for the company. |
| TaxJar Sync Failed | Read the message below the title. |

## Credit Note Messages

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| Original Invoice Not Synced | Send the original invoice to TaxJar, then submit the credit note. |
| TaxJar: Missing Return Reference | Make the credit note from the original invoice: **Create** → **Return / Credit Note**. |
| {customer} has no submitted invoice. | Submit an invoice for the customer, then make the credit note. |
| Please select a Sales Invoice | Select the original invoice in the dialog. |

## Customer Messages

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| Nothing to Sync To | No company uses TaxJar. Check the companies in TaxJar Setup. |
| Company Not Allowed | The company does not use TaxJar. Check the companies in TaxJar Setup. |
| Customer Not Deleted | TaxJar could not remove the customer. Wait, then delete the customer again. |
| Not Sent | The customer waited too long in the queue. Select the row and click **Resync with TaxJar**. |
| Exempt Region Required | Select at least one exempt region, or click **Select All**. |
| …exemption details were saved but not sent to TaxJar. | TaxJar is off, or no company uses TaxJar. Fix the cause, then send the customer again. |

## Access Messages

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| You do not have {right} access to {document type}, ask your administrator to update permissions for your user. | Ask an administrator to give the role for the task. Refer to [Permissions by Task](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions#permissions-by-task). |
| A TaxJar Manager can fetch them from TaxJar. | Only a TaxJar Manager can update the nexus or the categories. |

## Upgrade Messages

| Message | Fix |
|---|---|
| Live Mode Required | Change **API Mode** to **Live** in TaxJar Setup, then run the check. |
| Nothing to Check | No version 15 invoice waits for the check. Nothing to do. |
| A TaxJar Manager can run the check. | Ask a TaxJar Manager to run the check. |

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/api-log

# API Log

The TaxJar API Log records each request that the app sends to TaxJar, and each answer. Use it when an error message is not enough.

::: tip
**Enable API Logs** must be on in [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup#connect). To read the log, you need read on TaxJar API Log, for example the **Accounts User** role.
:::

## Find the Entries of a Document

1. In the TaxJar sidebar, open **Other** → **TaxJar API Logs**.
2. Filter by **Reference Name** to find one document, or by **Company** to find one company.
3. Open the entry with the status <Badge type="danger" text="error" />.
4. Read **Error** and **Response**.

![The TaxJar API Log list with the Action, Status, Reference DocType and Reference Name columns](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/api-log-list.webp)

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| <Badge type="info" text="request" /> | The app sent a request. |
| <Badge type="tip" text="success" /> | TaxJar accepted the request. |
| <Badge type="danger" text="error" /> | TaxJar did not accept the request, or the app could not reach TaxJar. |
| <Badge type="warning" text="skipped" /> | The app did not send the request. **Error** gives the reason. |
| <Badge type="info" text="reused" /> | The app kept the sales tax that was already on the document, and did not send a request. Refer to [Tax Computation](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-tax/tax-computation#recalculation-rules). |

::: info
The app writes error entries in the background. A new error entry can take up to 15 minutes to show.
:::

## Log Retention

The app deletes logs after the number of days in **Retention**. The default is 15 days, and 0 keeps all logs.

1. Open **TaxJar Setup**, and click **Edit configuration**.
2. On the **Connect** step, change **Retention**.
3. Click **Save & continue**.

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/scheduled-jobs

# Scheduled Jobs

The app runs these jobs on a schedule. You do not start them.

| How Often | Job | What It Does | Runs When Off |
|---|---|---|:-:|
| **Every 15 Minutes** | Invoice Retry | Sends failed invoices and cancellations again, when the error is temporary. | - |
|  | Customer Retry | Sends failed customers again, when the error is temporary. A customer that waited more than 15 minutes in the queue becomes Failed first. | - |
| **Daily** | Nexus Update | Gets the nexus states of each company from TaxJar. On a failure, it sends a notification to the TaxJar users. Refer to [Daily Update Failure](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus#daily-update-failure). | - |
|  | Log Cleanup | Deletes the TaxJar API Log entries that are older than **Retention**. With 0, it keeps all entries. | ● |
|  | Usage Summary | Sends a summary of the use of the app, only when usage data is on. Refer to [Usage Data & Feedback](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/usage-data-and-feedback). | ● |
| **Weekly** | Category Update | Gets the TaxJar product tax categories, and adds only the new ones. | - |

**Runs When Off:** the job also runs when TaxJar is off in **TaxJar Settings**. The other jobs do nothing then.

## Retry Rules

| Rule | Value |
|---|---|
| Tries for each document | Up to 5. After that, send it yourself. Refer to [Resolve Failed Syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs). |
| Documents in each run | 50 invoices and 50 customers |
| Company with no API token | The failure does not count as a try. The app sends the document after you add the token. |
| Company that no longer syncs | The app does not retry it. |

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/taxjar-pages-and-settings

# TaxJar Pages & Settings

## Sidebar Pages

| Section | Link | Use It To |
|---|---|---|
| **Home** | TaxJar Integration | See the setup state and open the other pages. |
| **Setup** | TaxJar Setup | Do the [Guided Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup), and change the setup. |
|  | Customer Tax Exemption | [Exempt many customers](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption#bulk-exemption), and fix customer syncs. |
|  | Nexus & Product Category | Update the [nexus states](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus) and the [product tax categories](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/item-tax-exemption). |
| **Reports** | TaxJar Transaction Sync | [Close the period](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-return-filing/period-close-and-filing), and [fix failed syncs](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/resolve-failed-syncs). |
| **Other** | TaxJar API Logs | [Read the requests and the answers](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/troubleshoot/api-log). |
|  | TaxJar API Settings | Turn TaxJar on or off, and run the [version 15 check](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/upgrade-from-version-15). |

::: tip
The **Other** section is closed by default. Click **Other** to open it.
:::

## Fields on ERPNext Forms

| Form | Field or Section | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| **Quotation, Sales Order, Sales Invoice** | **TaxJar** tab | The ship-from and ship-to addresses and the Tax Applicability Matrix. |
|  | **TaxJar Exemptions**, below **Net Total** | The exemption of one sale. |
|  | **TaxJar Tax Breakdown**, below the totals | The tax for each jurisdiction. |
| **Sales Invoice** | **TaxJar Status** in the sidebar | The sync status. |
|  | **Transaction Sync** on the **TaxJar** tab | The sync status. |
| **Customer** | **TaxJar Tax Exemption** on the **Tax** tab | The exemption. |
|  | **TaxJar Sync Details** on the **Tax** tab | The sync status of the customer. |
| **Item** | **Product Tax Category**, below **Item Group** | The TaxJar category of the item. |
| **Address** | **State Code (US)** | The two-letter US state code. |
|  | **Region Code (ISO 3166-2)** | The region code that TaxJar needs. |

The TaxJar fields show only for a company that uses TaxJar.

## Setup & Settings Labels

TaxJar Setup and the TaxJar Settings form use different labels for the same company switches.

| TaxJar Setup | TaxJar Settings |
|---|---|
| **Compute Taxes on Sales** | **Calculate Sales Tax** |
| **Sync Transactions to TaxJar** | **Sync Transactions** |
| **Domestic + Export** | **Include Export Transactions**, set |

::: tip
Change the configuration in [TaxJar Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup), not in the TaxJar Settings form.

# Upgrade from Version 15

Do these steps only if your site used TaxJar with ERPNext version 15. A new site does not need them.

## What Changes

| Data | Version 15 | After the Upgrade |
|---|---|---|
| **Exempt Customer** | **Exempt From Sales Tax** set | Exemption type **Other**, exempt in all US states and Canadian provinces. |
| **Exempt Sale** | **Exempt From Sales Tax** set on a quotation, sales order or sales invoice | **Is transaction exempt from sales tax?** set, with the reason **Other**. |
| **Nexus** | Rows with no company | <Badge type="danger" text="Deleted" /> TaxJar Setup gets the nexus again for each company. |
| **Older Invoices** | Submitted before the upgrade | <Badge type="info" text="Excluded" /> with the reason "Submitted before upgrade, not yet checked". |
| **Print Format** | **US Sales Tax Invoice** | Renamed to **US Sales Tax (Invoice, DN, CN)**. |

::: info
The upgrade does not change a record that already has an exemption of the new version.
:::

## Upgrade Steps

<ol class="steps">
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="run-taxjar-setup-again">Run TaxJar Setup Again</h3><span>Do the six steps in Live mode, and activate.</span></summary>

1. Open **TaxJar Setup** and do all six steps. Refer to [Guided Setup](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/guided-setup).
2. On the **Connect** step, set **API Mode** to **Live**.
3. Click **Activate**.

The app then sends each customer exemption that version 15 did not send, and starts the invoice check in the background.

::: tip Check the Exempt Customers
After the upgrade, each exempt customer is exempt in all regions. If a customer is exempt only in some states, change its regions. Refer to [Customer Tax Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption).
:::

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="check-older-invoices">Check Older Invoices</h3><span>Ask TaxJar which invoices from version 15 it holds.</span></summary>

Version 15 sent invoices to TaxJar, but it did not record this on the invoice. The check asks TaxJar which of these invoices it holds, and sets the correct status on each one.

::: tip
Only a TaxJar Manager can run the check. The check runs in Live mode only, so each company needs a Live token.
:::

1. Open **TaxJar API Settings** in the TaxJar sidebar, under **Other**.
2. Click the **Migration** tab. The card **TaxJar Invoice Sync Status** shows the **Upgrade Date** and **Last Checked**.
3. Click **Run check**. The progress shows "Month {n} of {total}". You can leave the page.

To run the check again, click **Run again**.

![The Migration tab of TaxJar Settings on a site that did not upgrade from version 15. The card shows "Nothing to check on this site"](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/images/upgrade-migration-tab.webp)

On a site that did not upgrade, the tab shows "Nothing to check on this site", as above.

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="read-the-results">Read the Results</h3><span>See the result of the check for each company.</span></summary>

The table has one row for each company. The columns **Invoices**, **Found**, **Not Found** and **Stale in TaxJar** count the invoices. "Stale" means that you cancelled the invoice in ERPNext, but TaxJar still holds it.

| Result | Meaning | What to Do |
|---|---|---|
| <Badge type="tip" text="All Found" /> | TaxJar holds all the invoices. | Nothing. |
| <Badge type="danger" text="Needs Review" /> | Some invoices are not in TaxJar, or are stale. | Do [Fix the Results](#fix-the-results). |
| <Badge type="danger" text="Failed" /> | TaxJar did not answer. | Check the Live token in TaxJar Setup, then click **Run again**. |
| <Badge type="warning" text="No Credential" /> | The company has no Live token. | Add a Live token, then run the check. |
| <Badge type="warning" text="Sandbox Mode" /> | The site is in Sandbox mode. | Change to Live, then run the check. |
| <Badge type="info" text="Not Checked" /> | The check did not run for this company. | Click **Run check**. |

**New invoice statuses:**

| Invoice in ERPNext | In TaxJar | New Status |
|---|---|---|
| **Submitted** | Found | <Badge type="tip" text="Synced" /> |
|  | Not found | <Badge type="info" text="Excluded" /> "Not found in TaxJar, submitted before upgrade" |
| **Cancelled** | Still there | <Badge type="danger" text="Failed" /> |

</details></li>
<li><details>
<summary><h3 id="fix-the-results">Fix the Results</h3><span>Send missing invoices, and remove stale ones.</span></summary>

Below the table, an alert shows for each company that needs work.

::::tabs
== Not in TaxJar
1. Click **Show not found**. The TaxJar Transaction Sync page opens with these invoices.
2. Open each invoice that must be in TaxJar.
3. Click **TaxJar** → **Sync to TaxJar**.

::: warning Run the Check First
The **Sync to TaxJar** button does not show on an invoice that waits for the check. This stops the app from sending an invoice that version 15 already sent.
:::
== Stale in TaxJar
1. Click **Show stale**. The TaxJar Transaction Sync page opens on the **Failed** tab.
2. Select the invoices and click **Resync**. The app deletes them from TaxJar.
::::

</details></li>
</ol>

---

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/usage-data-and-feedback

# Usage Data & Feedback

The TaxJar Integration sends usage data to Frappe, to make the app better. It also asks users to rate the app from time to time.

## When the App Sends Data

The app sends usage data only when both of these are true:

- The site has a Frappe usage-data key. Frappe Cloud sites have one. A self-hosted site does not, so it sends nothing.
- **Allow Sending Usage Data for Improving Applications** is on in **System Settings**.

::: tip
To stop all usage data, turn off **Allow Sending Usage Data for Improving Applications** in **System Settings**. This setting applies to all Frappe apps on the site.
:::

## What the App Sends

All usage data is about the site. No event has a user ID, a name or an email.

| Data | Example |
|---|---|
| **Daily Summary** | How many companies use TaxJar, which features are on, how many documents TaxJar calculated tax on, how many invoices synced in the last 30 days, how many invoices failed to sync, and how many calls the app made to TaxJar, by type. |
| **Setup Progress** | Which setup steps were opened, saved or failed. Which setup videos were played. When the setup was finished. |
| **First Use** | The first time TaxJar calculated tax, and the first time an invoice synced. |
| **Problems** | A tax calculation that TaxJar refused, and its error code. A submit that the app stopped, and the reason. |
| **Actions** | A bulk retry, an exemption change, an export, a nexus refresh. The app sends how many records, not which records. |
| **Feedback** | A score from 1 to 5, and the comment if the user wrote one. |

The site name, the Frappe Cloud team and the version numbers of the app and of Frappe go with each event, as for all Frappe apps.

## What the App Never Sends

| Data | Example |
|---|---|
| **Names** | Users, customers, companies and items |
| **Contact Details** | Email addresses, street addresses and phone numbers |
| **Document Data** | Amounts, tax rates and document numbers |
| **Credentials** | The TaxJar API token |

## Feedback Card

A card **Rate the TaxJar app** shows in the TaxJar sidebar. **Give feedback** opens a short form with a score from 1 to 5 and an optional comment.

**Who sees it:** <Badge type="info" text="Accounts User" /> and <Badge type="info" text="Accounts Manager" />

**When it shows:** all three of these are true.

- Usage data is on. Refer to [When the App Sends Data](#when-the-app-sends-data).
- The guided setup is finished.
- TaxJar calculated tax or synced an invoice on the site.

**When it shows again:**

| After You | The Card Shows Again |
|---|---|
| Send a score | 30 days later |
| Close the card | 15 days later |
| Click **Do not ask me again** | Never |

::: info Feedback Is Anonymous
Do not write personal information in the comment. The app removes formatting and hidden characters from the comment, and keeps the first 1,000 characters.
:::

Source: https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/reference/glossary

# Glossary

## Sales Tax

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Destination-based tax** | The state uses the rate of the ship-to address. |
| **Exemption** | A customer or a sale that pays no sales tax, for example a reseller. Refer to [Customer Tax Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/customer-tax-exemption). |
| **Exempt region** | A US state or Canadian province where a customer's exemption applies. |
| **Export** | A sale with a ship-to country that is not the United States. It has no US sales tax. |
| **Jurisdiction** | A level of government that charges sales tax: the state, the county, the city or a special district. |
| **Nexus** | A legal connection to a state. You collect sales tax only in your nexus states. Refer to [Updating your nexus](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/updating-your-nexus). |
| **Origin-based tax** | The state uses the rate of the ship-from address. |
| **Product tax category** | A TaxJar code that tells TaxJar how states tax an item. Refer to [Item Tax Exemption](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/tax-exemptions/item-tax-exemption). |

## Documents & Sync

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Credit note** | A sales invoice with **Is Return (Credit Note)** set. TaxJar records it as a refund. Refer to [Credit & Debit Notes](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/sales-adjustments/credit-and-debit-notes). |
| **Debit note** | A sales invoice that adds an amount to an earlier invoice. TaxJar records it as an order. |
| **Ship from** | The company address with **Preferred Billing Address** set. |
| **Ship to** | The shipping address of the document. If it is empty, the app asks for one when you save. |
| **Sync** | The app sends a submitted invoice, credit note or customer to TaxJar. Refer to [Syncing to TaxJar](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/transaction-sync/syncing-to-taxjar). |
| **TaxJar Sales Tax template** | The tax template that TaxJar Setup makes for each company, with a shipping row and a sales tax row. |
| **Transaction** | An order or a refund in TaxJar, made from an invoice or a credit note. |

## TaxJar Account

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **API token** | The key from TaxJar that lets the app use one TaxJar account. Each company has a Live token and a Sandbox token. |
| **AutoFile** | A TaxJar service that files your sales tax returns from the transactions in your TaxJar account. |
| **Live mode** | The API mode for real business. TaxJar records the transactions. Refer to [Before you go live](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/before-you-go-live). |
| **Persona** | A type of TaxJar user: TaxJar Manager or TaxJar User. It is not an ERPNext role. Refer to [Roles & Permissions](https://regional.frappe.io/usa/sales-tax/pr-preview/pr-35/setting-up/roles-and-permissions). |
| **Sandbox mode** | The API mode for tests. TaxJar does not record the transactions. |
